For an in-stock rug, delivery is roughly 2–8 business days: 1–3 business days for warehouse processing, followed by 1–5 business days in transit. Promotions and holidays can add another 2–3 business days. Tumble doesn’t offer expedited shipping.

If an item is a pre-order or has extended processing, its estimated ship date is shown on the product page, in the cart, and in the order confirmation email 🙂
